mesa.role: Statically linked headless lavapipe, llvmpipe, NIR and Vulkan runtime

glslang.role: Build-host shader generator only; not linked into the executable

llvm.role: Cosmopolitan static X86 MCJIT with explicit SysV target and C symbol registration

source_policy: Download and verify complete release archives under o/lavapipe. Apply only the checked-in patches. No Mesa source pruning; no system Mesa, Vulkan loader or LLVM library is linked.
target: x86_64 Cosmopolitan APE, headless Vulkan software compute
